editorial:
Be Big! is a 1931 Laurel and Hardy two-reel sound comedy made at Hal Roach Studios, directed by James W. Horne. Wikipedia gives its release date as February 7, 1931. A file named '046 Be Big.mp4' is listed in an Internet Archive Hal Roach two-reel compilation, but we have not confirmed that the file is the complete film.

The rights question is renewal. Searches of the 1958, 1959 and 1960 Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes for "be big" found no renewal for Be Big!. Those searches did not cover the volumes page by page, and OCR can miss entries. So the print is not marked verified public domain. Check the Hal Roach renewal pages of those volumes by hand before relying on it.
faq: We found no renewal in text searches of the 1958, 1959 or 1960 Catalog of Copyright Entries volumes. Those searches were not page-by-page and OCR may hide an entry, so a manual page check is still needed.
Can I use the Internet Archive copy?

A file named '046 Be Big.mp4' is listed inside a compilation item. We have not confirmed that it is the complete film, and its provenance is not documented here. If the renewal check clears, the film itself may be free to reuse. Clear any added material in a particular transfer before reuse. We found no source on the status of the score and soundtrack, so do not assume they follow the film.
